expected: The message names the real buttons: tap 'Unlink Google Drive', then 'Find my Drive backup'.
who: members restoring an old Drive backup
how_often: every time Drive's permission has expired

title: Backup line blames the internet for an item the server refused
what: An item the server refuses stays in the waiting list and is tried every 6 hours. Settings then shows '1 change is waiting for the internet' even when the phone is online, and the 'Last saved' time is never shown again while it waits.
expected: A refused or not-yet-ready item is told apart from changes waiting for the internet, and the 'Last saved' time still shows.
who: signed-in members with an item the server will not take
fix_line: Count only items waiting for the internet in the line, and say plainly when one could not be saved
